Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

package DynamicProgramming;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class LongestIncreasingSub {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = { 5, 8, 7, 1, 9 };
        int max = helper(arr, 0, new ArrayList<>());
        System.out.print(max);
    }

    public static int helper(int[] arr, int curr, ArrayList<Integer> result) {
        if (curr == arr.length) {
            return result.size();
        }
        if (!result.isEmpty()) {
            if (result.get(result.size() - 1) > arr[curr]) {
                int pick = helper(arr, curr + 1, result.add(arr[curr]));
                int notpick = helper(arr, curr + 1, result);
            }
        }

    }
}
